scope: Finite stage closure rules; planned tests are NOT_RUN and no product pass is granted by this document.

policy.entry_rule: Complete stage minimum prerequisites and exact leaf task prerequisites; freeze that leaf contract/oracle/profile before production implementation. Contract preparation and XADB-046 inventory work may proceed earlier.
policy.closure_rule: Frozen nonempty required inventory, all required task/variant cases VERIFIED_PASS on identified candidate, affected lower-level regressions PASS, resources/cleanup/evidence complete, zero unresolved required decisions or blockers. Missing entrypoint/evidence is NOT_RUN, not PASS.
policy.local_evidence_rule: DEV0/DEV1 LOCAL_VERIFIED permits scoped local dependent development; does not satisfy protected CI, official distribution, all PA/KU cases or release promotion.
policy.internal_distribution_rule: A declared internal capability needs its complete current-build closure record plus pinned execution environment and protected evidence review/promotion; no previous internal compatibility. These promotion obligations are currently NOT_RUN.
policy.scope_rule: Stage closure uses all required work packages. A subset capability may be verified and distributed with its own manifest; stage remains incomplete. Deferred required replacement functions cannot be N/A.
policy.applicability_rule: Expand every case into concrete variants. For cases spanning future components, run all currently supported variants and register the remaining obligation with owner task and trigger capability; never mark the whole unexecuted case PASS. Rerun affected cases when the component arrives.
policy.version_rule: VERSION_RELEASE only for customer delivery. Internal cross-version result NOT_REQUIRED_INTERNAL_FRESH_BUILD; no prior customer baseline NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_RELEASE_BASELINE. Current-build correctness always required.
policy.evidence_destination: Future actual runs retain immutable per-run bundles under artifacts/<stage>/<run-id>; a stage report references their hashes. No future report exists yet.
policy.verification_profile_rule: DP03 adds applicable initial budgets to future harnesses. Concrete leaf variants, cut/schedule lists and limits remain required; no saved evidence is upgraded. LOCAL_VERIFIED development may continue without future distribution or AI pilot implementation.

cases.title: 독립 행·거래 정답 모델
cases.acceptance: 작은 명시적 상태/직렬 이력 oracle로 read/write/delete, snapshot, commit/abort/UNKNOWN을 판정한다. lost update, write skew, phantom, partial batch, ACK 유실의 known-bad 이력을 모두 거절한다. production row/codec/replay를 정답 계산에 재사용하지 않는다.

cases.title: 최소 SQL 전체 문법·오류 행렬

SQL 텍스트에 bind 값을 삽입하는 방식으로 대체하지 않는다.
